[attribute-continued-from]
=== `@continued-from` Continued From (list continuation)

An `IDREF`-type attribute that points to the <<attribute-id,`@id`>> attribute of a list which the current list continues; used to connect discontiguous lists that constitute one logical list.

#### Usage/Remarks
This attribute was inherited from JATS and may be uncommon in standards.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>>, 
                  <<element-list,`<list>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| A pointer (IDREF)| Points to the existing identifier (<<attribute-id,`@id`>>) of a  list element, to mark the current list as continued from the targeted (pointed
                        to) list, which may be a list (<<element-list,`<list>`>>) or a definition list (<<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>>).
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
